name: free-coding-agent-ui
description: TypeScript web UI for the Coding Agent

scripts.verify-client: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const code = fs.readFileSync('dist/client/app.js', 'utf8'); if (/Object\.defineProperty\(exports/.test(code) || /module\.exports/.test(code) || /exports\.[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+\s*=\s*[^\.]/.test(code)) { console.error('ERROR: CommonJS export assignment found in client bundle!'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('Client bundle verification passed: valid ESM bundle with no CommonJS export leaks.'); }"
